# Material Symbols

The interface icons in `core/designsystem/src/main/res/drawable/core_designsystem_ic_*.xml` are
[Material Symbols](https://fonts.google.com/icons) (Rounded, weight 400, grade 0, 24 dp; filled
where noted in each file), converted to vector drawables from
[google/material-design-icons](https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/tree/master/symbols/web).
Licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE`).

The app icon (the lauburu), the cast and the scenes are Hitz's own.
